parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the gateway cluster. The description cannot exceed 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

parameters.name: StorageBundleId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway cluster.
